lede: The Fourth of July weekend takes center stage this week, with the Telluride parade on Saturday the 4th, a drone show Friday night, Better Than Ezra, the Red White and Blues celebrations in both town and Mountain Village, and the Bright Light Social Hour running two nights at the Alibi. On the government side, the county commissioners have three meetings scheduled for July 8 — including two specials and a work session — but none have posted agendas yet, so there's nothing actionable to track down quite yet.
